title: Entrepreneurship — experiential course and placement
format: One lecture per week plus thematic homework alongside a real startup; office hours with active startup operators
summary: Knowledge made practical by pairing every lecture with work inside a live venture — from converting an idea into a company through to pitching it.

title: Digital Technology in Business — modular series
format: Standalone lectures or a sequenced series; each module runs 60–120 minutes
summary: Around six hours of refined material on advanced digital technology applied to modern business, extensible to fifteen or more by drawing on published research.
